safety_notes: Set safety planes and speed limits on the pendant before running the agent.

vision.calibration_source: Factory intrinsics read from the D405 (serial 260422275184) at 640x480 RGB; not a measured calibration.

calibration.tcp_definition: UR tool0 flange frame, +z out of the flange toward the fingers. Translation below is the Robotiq 2F-85 fingertip offset, measured with a ruler (150 mm, about +/-2 mm).

calibration_note: Camera intrinsics are the D405 factory values. link6_from_tcp (0.15 m) is a ruler measurement; link6_from_camera.left is a hand-eye fit to a chessboard of 8x5 inner corners (two runs, var/handeye/20261027-200250 and 20261027-212335, 18 poses, 0.74 px corner RMS). The printed squares measure 14.0 mm, not the 13 mm first assumed: the D405 depth (14.08 mm) and the robot's own motion (14.04 mm) agree; confirm with a ruler. Expect about a millimetre of error at the board and verify it before precise work. Set the controller's own TCP to zero so RTDE poses are flange poses.
